purpose: Summarize the completed OWL feedback framing run without rerunning a model or validator.
claim_boundaries: The 30 rows are paired observations of a case and a condition, not 30 independent cases.
A model output failure is not a valid inconsistent graph.
Removal of the controlled target and OWL consistency are different outcomes.
Exact recovery concerns the clean controlled reference graph, not all source facts.
Grounding findings describe the locked assessor, not human review of each assertion.
The explanation is derived from controlled construction, not a newly generated reasoner explanation.
Results are descriptive paired comparisons over ten controlled cases. No population claim or claim of statistical dominance is made.
